calls.summary: Margaret Ellison called to compare her current coverage against the Humana Full Access PPO Medicare Advantage plan after seeing a mailer for 2026. Agent Oscar confirmed her ZIP had a $0 premium option and walked her through in and out of network copays. She scheduled an enrollment appointment with a licensed agent for the following week.

Harold Bennett wanted a quote on the Humana Extend bundle so his dental, vision and hearing benefits would sit under one monthly payment. Agent Lila explained there were no waiting periods for preventive dental and confirmed pricing for his area. Harold booked an enrollment appointment to finalize the Extend plan.

Doris Falkner asked how the $0 giveback plan puts money back into her Social Security check every month. Agent Rosey verified her eligibility, confirmed the local PPO included prescription drug coverage, and answered her questions about the monthly credit. Doris scheduled an enrollment appointment to switch to the giveback plan.

Gloria Mendez is newly eligible for Medicare and called to set up a review of her options, including the Humana Extend dental, vision and hearing bundle. Agent Lee collected her full name, date of birth, ZIP code and current prescriptions so a licensed agent could prepare plan comparisons. Gloria scheduled a new enrollment appointment for the following Tuesday.

Walter Simmons wanted to know if he qualified for a D-SNP since he receives Medicaid, and whether a Medicare Advantage plan would give him $0 copays on his prescriptions. Agent Mary confirmed his dual eligibility and explained the Healthy Options Allowance for over the counter items. Walter scheduled an enrollment appointment to complete the D-SNP application.

Betty Kowalski called with questions about the giveback plan and how the monthly credit would appear alongside her Social Security deposit. Agent Sue clarified the timing and confirmed her doctor accepted the plan. Betty agreed to move forward and scheduled an enrollment appointment.

Frank Delgado disputed a charge on his individual dental plan, saying he was billed twice for the same month. Agent Mike located the duplicate premium, opened a correction request and explained the refund would post in 24-48h. Frank stayed on his dental plan but no new appointment was booked.

Ruth Castellano called to check whether her Humana Part D drug plan covered a newly prescribed medication. Agent Jennifer looked up the formulary and confirmed the drug sat on a higher tier with a copay. Ruth wanted to think it over, so no enrollment appointment was scheduled.

Eugene Pratt reported that the Healthy Options Allowance card on his D-SNP was declined at the pharmacy. Agent Rose verified the balance, found a temporary hold and reset the card. Eugene was frustrated but the issue was resolved without booking anything new.

Nancy Whitfield called about an unexpected premium amount on her Part D prescription drug plan. Agent Oscar reviewed the billing history and explained a late enrollment adjustment had been applied. Nancy asked for a written breakdown and ended the call without scheduling an appointment.

Vernon Blake called after hours trying to reset his MyHumana login and check a claim status. The call rolled to voicemail and no agent was available. He left a callback number requesting help the next business day.

Clara Hoffman called to cancel her standalone vision plan because she was moving onto a spouse's group coverage. Agent Lila processed the cancellation and confirmed the effective end date. No new plan was scheduled.

Raymond Foss complained that a specialist he wanted was no longer listed in his provider network. Agent Lee searched nearby in network options but Raymond was unhappy with the choices. He asked to file a formal complaint and declined to schedule anything.

Stanley Ruiz was upset that his new dental plan card had not arrived and he could not confirm his effective date. Agent Mary confirmed the plan was active and reissued the card, but Stanley remained frustrated about the delay. No appointment was booked on the call.

Edith Marlowe disputed what she believed was a double charge on her Medicare Supplement premium. Agent Sue investigated but could not immediately locate a duplicate, which left Edith dissatisfied. She demanded escalation and the case was routed to billing review with no appointment scheduled.

prompts.question: Is the caller trying to solve a specific problem?
prompts.answer: The caller is a new Medicare beneficiary exploring affordable coverage options and wants to understand which Humana plan with dental benefits might fit their needs before the Annual Election Period closes on December 7.

prompts.question: What are the caller's expectations?
prompts.answer: The caller expects a straightforward conversation to learn about zero or low premium plans, confirm which plans cover dental care, and schedule a time to enroll with a licensed agent who can answer detailed questions.

prompts.question: How could the agent handle the call better?
prompts.answer: The agent should have captured the caller's email address for appointment confirmation and follow-up materials, clearly restated the exact appointment time and callback procedure, and explained what documents or information to prepare before the enrollment appointment.

transcript.text: Good afternoon and thank you for calling Humana enrollment support. My name is Marcus Bell. May I have your name please?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi Marcus. This is Eleanor Vasquez.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you Eleanor. I'm going to help you explore Humana Medicare plans available in your area. Are you calling about coverage for yourself?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Yes, that's right. I just turned 65 and I want to make sure I have good coverage with dental before the deadline.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect. I'm glad you called. What ZIP code is your primary residence located in?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I live in Louisville, Kentucky. That's 40202.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Excellent Eleanor. We have excellent plan options in 40202. Are you interested in a Medicare Advantage plan that includes both medical coverage and dental, or would you prefer to look at separate plans?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I think the Medicare Advantage with dental sounds good. What's the cost?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Great question. Many of our Humana Medicare Advantage plans in your ZIP code have zero dollar monthly premiums and include dental coverage. We also include vision and hearing benefits on several options. I'd love to have one of our licensed enrollment agents walk you through your personalized options.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: That sounds perfect. How do I schedule an appointment?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I can schedule you right now. What day works best for you this week to speak with an enrollment counselor?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Thursday afternoon would be great. I'm pretty flexible.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect. I've scheduled you for Thursday, October 24th at 2:00 PM. One of our licensed Humana agents will call you at the number we have on file. Can you please confirm your phone number for the callback?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you Eleanor. Your enrollment appointment is all set for Thursday at 2:00 PM. You'll receive a call from our licensed enrollment agent. They'll review your options, answer any questions about coverage, and help you select your plan. Welcome to Humana.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Thank you Marcus. I really appreciate the help.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're welcome Eleanor. Have a great day.

callDetail.aiSummary: Eleanor Vasquez, a new 65-year-old Medicare beneficiary from Louisville, Kentucky (40202), called to explore Humana Medicare Advantage plans with dental coverage before the Annual Election Period deadline. Marcus Bell qualified her for coverage in her service area, discussed zero premium plan options, and successfully scheduled an enrollment appointment for Thursday, October 24th at 2:00 PM with a licensed enrollment counselor. The call demonstrated strong structure and plan qualification, though the agent did not capture Eleanor's email address for appointment confirmation materials or provide detailed information about what to prepare for the enrollment visit.

comment.author: Kyle Paklaian
comment.text: @Marcus great foundation on this intake call. You nailed the greeting, captured all the essential qualification details, and booked the appointment smoothly. Two coaching tips: first, always ask for the caller's email address so we can send appointment confirmation and plan comparison documents before the call. That builds confidence and sets up the agent for success. Second, take five seconds to tell Eleanor what to expect during her Thursday appointment and remind her to have any current insurance cards or prescriptions handy. Those two moves will reduce no-shows and improve member satisfaction scores.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Humana, a licensed sales agent speaking. My name is Denise. Who do I have the pleasure of speaking with today?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi Denise, my name is Robert Feldman. I just turned 65 last month and I'm brand new to all of this Medicare stuff.
highlights: brand new to all of this Medicare stuff

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Congratulations and welcome, Robert. I'd be glad to walk you through your options. Can you tell me a little about what you're looking for in a plan?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Well, I want something that covers my doctors, and honestly I take a couple of prescriptions, so drug coverage matters to me.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's very common. A Medicare Advantage plan can bundle your medical and prescription coverage together. Do you have a ZIP code I can check for plans in your area?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Sure, it's 40218. But before we go too far, what does this run a month? I'm on a fixed income and I want to keep it manageable.
highlights: what does this run a month

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: I completely understand, Robert. The good news is in your area we have several plans with a $0 monthly premium, including our Humana Gold Plus HMO, which includes prescription drug coverage.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Zero dollars? See, that's the thing. My neighbor is with Aetna and he keeps telling me their plan is better. How do I know I'm not missing something?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: That's a fair question. What sets Humana apart is our broad, stable provider network and extras like dental, vision, and hearing built right in. I can compare your exact doctors and drugs side by side so you can see the difference clearly.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Okay, that would help. I also wanted to ask, do any of these put money back in my Social Security check? I saw something about that on TV.
highlights: money back in my Social Security check

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: They do. That's our $0 Local PPO giveback plan. It includes drug coverage and can put a portion of your Part B premium back into your monthly Social Security check. I can review that one for you as well.
highlights: back into your monthly Social Security check

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: That sounds good, but I don't want to feel locked into something I can't change later.
highlights: don't want to feel locked into something

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're never locked in, Robert. Medicare gives you enrollment windows each year to review and switch plans if your needs change, so you always have flexibility.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Alright, that puts me at ease. I'd probably want to go over the details with my wife before I decide anything, though.
highlights: go over the details with my wife

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Absolutely, that's a smart idea. Let's set up an enrollment appointment where I can pull up your doctors, your medications, and both giveback and Gold Plus options with you and your wife on the line.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: That works. Could we do Thursday morning? She's free then.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thursday at 10 AM is open. I have you booked for an enrollment appointment then. What's the best phone number and email to send the confirmation to?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: My cell is 502-555-0143 and email is rfeldman55 at gmail dot com.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Perfect, you're all set, Robert. You'll get a confirmation shortly and I'll call you Thursday at 10. Thank you for choosing Humana, and welcome aboard.

aiSummary.summary: Robert Feldman, a new-to-Medicare caller who just turned 65, phoned Humana looking for a plan that covers his doctors and prescriptions while staying affordable on a fixed income. The licensed agent, Denise, checked his ZIP code and recommended the $0 premium Humana Gold Plus HMO along with the $0 Local PPO giveback plan that returns money to his Social Security check. She addressed his cost, competitor, and commitment concerns and scheduled an enrollment appointment so he could review options with his wife. Contact details were captured for the follow-up.

qaPairs.question: What is a Medicare Advantage plan?
qaPairs.answer: A Medicare Advantage plan, also called Part C, includes all the benefits of Medicare Parts A and B, and most Humana plans add prescription drug coverage plus an annual out of pocket limit. I can book a quick review with a licensed Humana sales agent to find the right fit for you.

qaPairs.question: Do you have $0 premium plans?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, many Humana Medicare Advantage plans carry a $0 monthly premium, and some $0 Local PPO plans even put money back in your Social Security check each month. Let's confirm your ZIP so a licensed agent can show what's available near you.

qaPairs.question: What is the difference between the Gold Plus HMO and Full Access PPO?
qaPairs.answer: The Gold Plus HMO includes Parts A and B benefits with most plans adding drug coverage and an out of pocket limit, while the Full Access PPO lets you see any doctor that accepts Medicare at the same copay in or out of network with no referral. I can set up a review so an agent can compare them for your situation.

qaPairs.question: How much does a Humana dental plan cost?
qaPairs.answer: Humana dental plans start at around $18 a month, with most plans becoming effective in about 5 to 7 days, and pricing depends on the plan and your area. Let me connect you with a licensed agent for an exact quote in your ZIP.

qaPairs.question: What is included in the Humana Extend bundle?
qaPairs.answer: Humana Extend combines dental, vision and hearing into one plan with no waiting periods for preventive dental, vision and hearing exams, and one monthly payment instead of three. I can book a consultation to review the bundle options for you.

qaPairs.question: Does Humana cover my prescriptions?
qaPairs.answer: Humana Part D and most Medicare Advantage plans include prescription drug coverage, often with $0 Tier 1 copays, and coverage varies by plan formulary. A licensed agent can check your specific medications during a quick review, shall I set that up?

qaPairs.question: What is a D-SNP?
qaPairs.answer: A Dual Eligible Special Needs Plan is a $0 premium plan for people who qualify for both Medicare and Medicaid, offering $0 copays for preventive services, vaccinations and hundreds of prescriptions, many with a Healthy Options Allowance for over the counter items. Let me confirm your eligibility with a licensed agent.

qaPairs.question: When can I enroll in a Medicare plan?
qaPairs.answer: The Medicare Annual Election Period runs from October 15 to December 7, and other windows may apply based on your situation. I can book an appointment with a licensed Humana sales agent so you're ready when your window opens.

qaPairs.question: Do I need to keep my current doctor?
qaPairs.answer: With a Full Access PPO you can see any doctor that accepts Medicare, and Humana supports broad, stable provider networks in 48 states so you have choices. Let me set up a review so an agent can confirm your doctors are covered.

qaPairs.question: What is the giveback plan?
qaPairs.answer: The $0 Local PPO giveback plan includes prescription drug coverage and puts money back into your Social Security check every month. Availability depends on your ZIP, so let's confirm your area with a licensed agent.

qaPairs.question: How do I know which plan is right for me?
qaPairs.answer: The best plan depends on your doctors, prescriptions, budget and whether you qualify for extra help, and a licensed Humana sales agent can walk you through it. I can schedule a personalized review, would that be helpful?

qaPairs.question: Does Humana offer vision insurance?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Humana vision plans start at around $12 a month and cover preventive care and corrective options with plans to fit your lifestyle. Let me connect you with a licensed agent for exact pricing in your area.

qaPairs.question: What is Go365?
qaPairs.answer: Go365 is a wellness program included with many Humana plans that rewards preventive actions and encourages proactive management of your health. I can book a review to show how it works with the plan you're considering.

qaPairs.question: Can I get both dental and vision together?
qaPairs.answer: Yes, Humana offers dental as low as around $18 a month and vision as low as around $12 a month, available standalone or bundled to fit your budget. Let me set up a quick call to build a bundle for you.

qaPairs.question: What is Medigap or Medicare Supplement?
qaPairs.answer: A Humana Medicare Supplement plan fills the gaps in Original Medicare like coinsurance, copays and deductibles, and lets you see any doctor that accepts Medicare. A licensed agent can quote your plan by age and area, shall I schedule that?

qaPairs.question: How much is a Part D drug plan?
qaPairs.answer: Standalone Humana Part D plans generally run around $25 to $60 a month depending on the plan, and many include $0 Tier 1 copays. Let me set up a review so an agent can match a plan to your medications.

qaPairs.question: Are Humana plans available in my state?
qaPairs.answer: Humana serves members in 48 states with broad provider networks, and exact plans depend on your ZIP. Share your ZIP and I'll have a licensed agent confirm what's offered near you.

qaPairs.question: What is an I-SNP?
qaPairs.answer: The Humana Institutional Special Needs Plan is available in 13 states and includes dental, vision and hearing benefits, transportation to eligible medical appointments, care manager support and music therapy sessions. Let me connect you with an agent to check eligibility.

qaPairs.question: How long until my dental coverage starts?
qaPairs.answer: Most Humana dental plans become effective in about 5 to 7 days, and preventive dental in the Extend bundle has no waiting period. I can book a quick call to get you enrolled, would you like that?

qaPairs.question: Can I talk to a real person?
qaPairs.answer: Absolutely, licensed Humana sales agents are available Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 8 p.m., and I can book a time that works for you. What day and time should I set up your appointment?

convo.text: Hi there. Thanks for calling Humana. I'm helping members and prospects find the right Medicare plan for their needs. Are you currently on a Medicare plan, or would you be looking to enroll for the first time?
Hi, no I'm not currently enrolled. I'm turning 65 next month and I'm really interested in learning more about your Gold Plus HMO plan. I saw something about dental and vision benefits too.

That's wonderful, and congratulations on reaching Medicare eligibility. The Gold Plus HMO is a great choice with zero or low premiums depending on your zip code, and yes, most of our Gold Plus plans include dental, vision, and hearing benefits all in one. To help me find the best options for you in your area, what zip code do you live in?
I'm in Louisville, 40202. I also want to make sure any plan I pick covers my doctor. Dr. Sarah Chen at Norton Healthcare is my primary care physician.

Perfect. Dr. Chen at Norton is in our provider network for Louisville. Based on what you've told me, you'd be a great fit for our enrollment team to walk you through plan options, check your eligibility for any giveback benefits, and lock in your coverage before the December 7th enrollment deadline. Can I connect you with one of our licensed enrollment specialists? They're available right now and can have you set up in about 20 minutes.
